models.heading: Black and Red Wireless Gaming Headset
models.description: Looking for a black and red wireless gaming headset? See G920 product and fit views, its 2.4GHz USB receiver and device connection notes. Ask about OEM samples.
models.overview: Want a black and red option for your gaming range? G920 combines red frame accents and headband stitching with over-ear cushions, a boom microphone and a 2.4GHz USB receiver. See the headset on its own, then compare the illustrated gaming and streaming setups. Tell us which devices you want to support before choosing a sample.

faqs.question: Which G920 version is shown here?
faqs.answer: This page covers the black and red wireless G920, with a 2.4GHz USB receiver pictured. The wired-only G920 has a separate page; do not carry over its cable or accessory details.

faqs.question: Does the G920 diagram mean every device is compatible?
faqs.answer: No. It shows target-device examples. Check the exact device, USB audio host support, receiver or USB-C adapter and microphone input. Bluetooth pairing is not established by this diagram.

faqs.question: Are the G920 receiver and adapter standard accessories?
faqs.answer: The supplied graphic says a wireless receiver is included and pictures a USB-C adapter. Confirm the exact included set for your selected version and order. Pictured parts are not automatically included.

faqs.question: Can I ask for a black and red G920 sample?
faqs.answer: Use the G920-specific sample inquiry and share your target devices, market and branding needs. Review the headset, microphone, receiver and agreed accessory list before approving packaging artwork.

faqs.question: Does this G939 use 50mm drivers?
faqs.answer: Yes. The latest supplied G939 wireless graphics specify a 50mm dynamic driver. This replaces the older 40mm entry. The wired-only G939 remains a separate product page.

faqs.question: Does G939 connect by Bluetooth?
faqs.answer: The supplied connection diagram shows a 2.4GHz USB receiver and USB-C adapter, not Bluetooth pairing. Share the exact PC, console, phone or tablet so receiver compatibility and microphone input can be checked.

faqs.question: When can G939 reach up to 50 hours of playback?
faqs.answer: The supplied specification lists approximately 50 hours with lights off and a 1000mAh battery. Actual runtime depends on volume, wireless conditions and use. This is not a new battery test.

faqs.question: Are the G939 images an approved packing list?
faqs.answer: No. The graphic shows the headset, receiver with USB-C adapter, charging cable, 3.5mm audio cable and manual. Confirm the included set for your selected sample and order. Pictured parts are not automatically included.

faqs.question: Which G927 connection is documented here?
faqs.answer: The existing catalogue records 2.4GHz wireless use. The supplied graphics show a USB-A receiver with a USB-C adapter for desktop and laptop hosts. Bluetooth and 3.5mm wired audio remain to be confirmed for the selected version.

faqs.question: Does the USB-C adapter mean every device will work?
faqs.answer: No. USB-C describes the connector. Confirm host USB audio support, the selected receiver or adapter, headphone playback and microphone input on the exact device.

faqs.question: Is the G927 package graphic the final packing list?
faqs.answer: No. It is a packaging concept showing the headset, receiver and adapter. Agree the exact included set and final artwork for your order. Pictured parts are not automatically included.

faqs.question: Can I request an RGB G927 sample for my brand?
faqs.answer: Use the G927-specific inquiry and share your market, target devices and packaging needs. Review the base sample, microphone, receiver and accessory list before approving branding artwork.
